data.name: Ashlina
data.gender_notes: Ashlina is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ashlina is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ash’ meaning night and ‘Lina’ meaning Goddess. It is a name for the Goddess of the Night or Shakti, the divine feminine energy. The name Ashlina carries the meaning “Night Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ashlina usually hope their child will grow to embody night goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, power, and protection under the cover of night.
data.etymology: Ashlina belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashlina total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
